note: The cost S is Eq. (12) measured on the paper's STEP-RESPONSE episode (eval_model above): three +20 % steps, one channel per 5 s episode, each held, edges at 1/6/11 s, clean evaluation loop, metrics from true tensions. Main text 2.5 calls these 'step-response metrics' and normalises OS and t_s per channel by that channel's own |dT_ref,i|; the 16 s E_Toggle record is the *identification* protocol, not this episode. See docs/paper-v5.1-vs-dashboard-2026-09-07.md. Twin and reference are searched at the same paper budget, so S_achieved/S_ref_full is the comparable ratio; S_achieved/S_ref_coarse is kept as a second reading. A protocol outside these axes has no cell and must read 'not precomputed' -- never interpolate between neighbouring cells. Every cell records ti_scale_on_bound and kp_on_bound, so a boundary-pinned optimum is never presented as a free one; the plant's own auto_Ti is carried alongside as the engineering value.
